Tara (Mktg): Urgent mini-bundle for launch next Tue. Need drafts in 24h: 1) mobile-first benchmark micro-grid (3 cols: Latency p50, Cost/1k, 8-word quality note) with sparklines (SVG animated preferred, PNG fallback), 2) social cards (1200x628 + 1080x1080) with two CTA copies for A/B, 3) webinar hero + 1-slide TL;DR, 4) email header light/dark, 5) editable inbound routing diagram (SVG) showing canary split + telemetry hooks, 6) 1-page brand & localization checklist (include CSV of strings). Keep legal-safe and mobile-first.

Diego (Design): Quick q: animation ok if we also export static PNGs? Also CTA copy examples?

Tara (Mktg): Yes, include both. CTAs: "See the numbers" and "Compare latency & cost". Make CTA a separate Figma component for swaps.

Rae (Growth): Please provide 2x exports for socials and isolate CTA layer for ad platform. Also include a social carousel variant (3 slides) as optional.

Lina (PMM): Legal: no competitor names/logos; anonymize ("Open model A"). Accessibility: include alt-text and contrast ratios. Localization: CSV with key, en, de, jp and note about typical expansion % for each language. Add short disclaimer: "Representative workloads."

Diego (Design): Will do. Figma deliverables: page + exports + SVG diagram + animated sparkline GIF + checklist PDF + strings CSV. Specs: sparklines 64x12, micro-grid row 36px mobile, font Inter. ETA drafts 20h, final 48h.

DesignOps Bot: Reminder: upload drafts to /shared/launch-assets/5078901234/drafts and finals to /shared/launch-assets/5078901234/final. Tag: "microbench-5078". Set permissions marketing+design+growth.

Tara (Mktg): Great — ping @Rae and me when drafts are live. Prioritize mobile legibility and isolated CTA for quick swap. Thanks! :sparkles:
